sources.title: intent_classification: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases ...
sources.snippet: Overview intent_classification is a fine-tuned DistilBERT model purpose-built to classify user intent from text. Built by Falconsai, this model uses the distilbert-base-uncased architecture—a knowledge-distilled variant of BERT that maintains semantic understanding while reducing computational overhead. The model was fine-tuned on a curated dataset of under 50,000 samples across 100 epochs ...
